source_en: Going home from school on Lenina Street. Mom is waiting.
Going home to my mom. I found a shiny stone today.
Retrieving a lost toy from the park.
School let out early. The rain was black.
Going home to Mom. Only four of us came to school today.
Seeking shelter from the black rain.
Back from the census hall. They wrote my name in the big book.
Going home to Mom. My dolls are waiting for me too.
Fulfilling mandatory youth census.
Coming home from my night shift at the tram depot.
Picking up my son from kindergarten.
Driving home. I parked my car by the gate.
Back from university. My exams start next week.
Reporting to the factory. I was called in for the night shift.
Picking up my driving licence from the militia office.
Going home. I gave my dolls away, games are for babies.
Off duty from the census hall. I count the names there.
Taking my grandchildren home before the curfew.
Hello. My mom said I have to show you this paper.
It’s very loud out there. Is it always going to be this loud?
I found a shiny stone in the dirt. Do you want to see?
Why is your shadow so much longer than you are, mister?
The playground is empty. The swings move even when there’s no wind.
I can hear the buildings whispering. They’re cold and they want blankets.
I’m playing hide and seek with the sun. I think I won.
My dolls told me it’s time to go into the big sleep.
Is it tomorrow yet? Or is today just going to stay forever?
Thank you. I’m going to go see my mom now.
Don't let the bad air touch you, mister. It bites.
I’m going home to close my eyes. It’s prettier that way.
Is this a time-out? I didn't do anything wrong.
What? Mom will be mad at me if I'm late for dinner!
I’ll just wait here until the world finishes breaking.
I just... I just want to go home!
It’s getting very dark. I want to go home now.
Is the game over? I don't want to play anymore.
Am I in trouble? I didn’t break anything. I don’t think I broke anything.
It’s just like my corner at home. Except colder.
I’ll be very quiet. I’m good at being quiet. I’ve been practicing.
I didn’t do anything wrong… I was just standing here…
Is someone going to tell my mom? Can someone… tell my mom?
It’s getting very dark… and I just… I just want to go home now…
Where are you coming from?
School, on Lenina Street. Lots of empty desks today. I looked after the little ones at recess.
School. Only four of us came. The teacher sent us home early because the rain was black.
The census hall. A lady wrote my name in a big book. I told her my dolls' names too, so they get counted.
School, on Pushkin Street. I've gone there since first grade. It's always very quiet.
My papa's flat. I stay with him on weekdays now, and with Mama on Sundays.
From work. I help at the bread factory now that I'm fifteen.
Nowhere. I've always been here. Haven't I always been here?
The place with the long shadow. It told me to come and see you.
I don't remember coming. I just... arrived. Like the ash does.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Loud noises hurt my ears sometimes. If I hold very still, it goes away.
My tummy hurts at night. Mom says it's because I don't finish my soup. I checked, no fever.
I'm sleepy all the time. My dolls say that's normal now. Everybody's sleepy.
No. I never mind loud noises. I like it best when it's really, really loud.
Nothing hurts. My mom and my dad both checked me this morning.
I'm not sleepy. And I don't play pretend anymore. I'm too old for silly games.
My skin feels like it belongs to someone bigger.
Sometimes my hands don't feel like mine. I put them away when that happens.
I don't feel anything anymore. Is that bad? I think that's bad.
Your hat is very big. Does it fall over your eyes when it rains?
I found a shiny stone in the dirt today. Do you want to see it?
Is it always this loud out here? The city sounds like it is thinking very hard.
The swings near my building move even when there is no wind. Have you seen that?
Why is your shadow so much longer than you are, mister?
The buildings are whispering. I think they are cold. They want blankets.
I am playing hide and seek with the sun. I think I am winning.
My dolls told me to be polite to the officer. So. Hello.
Is today going to stay forever, or is tomorrow still coming?
